sermon.title: The Power of the Holy Spirit
sermon.speaker: Pastor Kincer
sermon.summary: The baptism of the Holy Ghost is for today and for all flesh. He leads into all truth and gives power to be a witness; the real power is to keep serving God no matter what, as Job did.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Peter said to them, “Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

‘And it shall come to pass in the last days, says God, That I will pour out of My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your young men shall see visions, Your old men shall dream dreams.
Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high.”
But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.”

chunks.section_question: What is the real power of the Spirit?
chunks.short_answer: He leads into all truth and gives power to be a witness; you may speak in tongues or prophesy, but the real power is to serve God no matter what, like Job.

scriptures.text_nkjv: However, when He, the Spirit of truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.

“You are the salt of the earth; but if the salt loses its flavor, how shall it be seasoned? It is then good for nothing but to be thrown out and trampled underfoot by men. “You are the light of the world. A city that is set on a hill cannot be hidden.

faqs.question: Is the Holy Ghost baptism for today?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Bible says it is poured on all flesh.

faqs.question: What does Acts 2:38 promise?
faqs.answer: The gift of the Holy Ghost.

faqs.question: What did Jesus tell them to wait for?
faqs.answer: To be endued with power from on high.

faqs.question: What does the power make us?
Does everyone filled speak in tongues?
Who leads us into all truth?
What is proof of being filled?
faqs.answer: Power to be a witness and live for Jesus.

faqs.question: What is the real power?
faqs.answer: Serving God no matter what, like Job.
